findings.criterion: Bug 'A resolved LLM-Review -1 cannot be re-evaluated: every re-trigger path hits a vote copy condition' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
findings.detail: The evidence search exhausted its bounded search without finding any demonstration that the reported defect no longer reproduces or that expected behavior holds. No code change, test result, or runtime evidence was produced to confirm resolution of the bug.
findings.remediation: Provide concrete evidence that the vote copy condition no longer blocks re-evaluation: e.g., a passing test, a code diff removing/narrowing the copy condition, or a recorded re-trigger run showing LLM-Review re-evaluating a patch set with a prior -1 vote.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[operator-attested]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify.
